title: Audit Round-Count Calibration via Convergence-Saturation Signal
summary: Default audit round count is 3; round 4 fires only when the Convergence-Saturation Signal (R3: P1 = 0, P2-new ≤ 1, no new framings) has not triggered; round 5 only if R4 surfaces a new P1; rounds beyond 5 need explicit practitioner authorization. A structured verdict line closes each round. Form-change events reset the round-count baseline (the first audit on a new form is its R1). Skill-Structure Layer in argument-auditor.md and citation-auditor.md.

links.note: Skill-Structure Layer application at audit-round-end; the verdict line is the audit-bearing artifact; threshold recalibration after 2–4 cycles is the graduation trigger
same tier, distinct workflow point: round-count calibration at audit-round-end versus loop termination at research-loop-end
the form-change baseline-reset rule governs the WP-D narrow audit on the derived ADR-099/100 markdown (R1 on the new form)
pre-triage runs after the round's verdict line is read; the round decision precedes finding dispositions (preservation scenario)
